{{Quote|I never saw a fighter wing take out a ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer before&hellip;and we got all our ships away besides. Not one single transport got tagged.|Motto Shemson|<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />}}
The '''Battle of Xyquine II''' was fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when [[Cracken Flight Group|Cracken's Flight Group]] under [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] covered the evacuation of the [[Xyquine base|Rebel base]] on [[Xyquine II]] without taking a single loss. During the battle, Cracken invented the [[Cracken Twist]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Cracken Flight Group|Cracken's Flight Group]] was stationed on [[Xyquine II]], at a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Xyquine base|base]] from which they undertook frequent shipping raids. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] became aware of the base's location when a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] located the base.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Cracken Flight Group requests permission to make the Imperials reconsider their attack strategy, sir!|Pash Cracken, to Gingal|<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />}}
At a time when a major covert Rebel operation was taking place and several prominent Rebels happened to be in the system&mdash;including [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]&mdash;an Imperial force including at least one [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] entered the system once all fifty Rebel sensor drones covering the area were disabled.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref><ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" /> The cessation of the drones' transmissions was noticed by communications technician [[Motto Shemson]], who alerted [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gingal]], the watch commander. Gingal called for an evacuation in the twenty minutes before the Imperial forces reached the base, but [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] burst into the control room to warn the senior officer that the Imperials would be able to listen to Rebel transmissions once they launched. He suggested that, to counter it, Rebel crews be briefed in advance to subtract two from the second digit of the exit vector coordinates that would be transmitted&mdash;a deception that would throw off Imperial pursuit. Gingal agreed to the plan, increasing the second digit of the transmitted vector by two.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

Cracken led his flight group into the air and against the enemy's ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer. Without taking a single casualty, the fighters destroyed the capital ship, allowing every single Rebel to escape the base without any losses.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

==Aftermath==
The Battle of Xyquine II proved significant due to Cracken's invention of what came to be known as the [[Cracken Twist]]. The predetermined alteration of a digit of a transmitted vector when Imperial eavesdropping was feared became a standard Alliance and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] tactic.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Xyquine II was first mentioned in ''[[The Last Command]]'', in which Han Solo mentions that the battle was "two years ago" as of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TLC" /> ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', however, places it prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later resused the information from both the novel and the sourcebook in different entries, contradicting itself.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', "Cracken, Pash" & "Xyquine"</ref>
